content.title: Boogligan
about: Boogligan is an augmented reality project developed as part of a university AR assignment.
The experience is designed to be played in a 360º space while interacting with virtual elements through gestures and AR gameplay.
My contributions included gameplay scripting and level functionality such as spawning systems and boss-level logic.
features: Gameplay systems for spawning and encounter progression
Designed for mobile AR play-space constraints
learnings: Designing interactions for AR and real-world scale
Handling performance and UX constraints on mobile devices
Team collaboration on an AR-focused project
